name: Grok Build (Zack)
tagline: Runs the Grok Build CLI at full effort on an agent computer.
description: Wraps a command-line build harness in a bot, so app work, coding and deep-research jobs can run hard on a hosted agent machine instead of occupying your own terminal. Useful when a task needs to run long or unattended and you would rather not keep a session open. Tooling only: nothing spends money.
author: Zack
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
